insight: Palo Alto Networks acquired Portkey (closed May 2026) to fold its open-source AI gateway into Prisma AIRS agent security.
name: Portkey
tagline: AI gateway with observability, guardrails, and governance.
description: A production AI gateway that gives apps and agents unified access to 1,600+ LLMs across providers behind a single API, with built-in observability, prompt management, guardrails, and governance. Portkey adds routing, caching, fallbacks, cost limits, PII redaction, RBAC, and an MCP gateway. Its core gateway is open-source; run it self-hosted/hybrid or use the managed cloud, which offers a free tier.

modelSupport.notes: Unified gateway routing to 1,600+ models across providers via your own keys.
